_manifest_note: Verbatim capture of GET https://www.phoenixopendata.com/api/3/action/datastore_search?resource_id=eddd36ce-c425-4e78-aa40-5dac5367a3b2&limit=2 - HTTP 200, total=4884, retrieved 2026-09-03 by the build agent's own request. Fields and records are unmodified. Test fixture only.

info.label: Incident Report Number
info.notes: Record number to use as a unique identifier for each incident. More than one officer and/or individual may be involved in an incident.

info.label: Police Employee Unique Identifier
info.notes: Reference number to use as unique identifier for officers.

info.label: Date
info.notes: Date when the Use of Force interaction occurred.

info.label: Year
info.notes: Year when the Use of Force interaction occurred.

info.label: Police Employee Gender / Sex
info.notes: Gender/sex of police employee (e.g., Female, Male, Not Available) who used force. Note that there can be more than one police employee who used force in the same incident.

info.label: Police Employee Race/ Ethnicity Grouping
info.notes: Race / ethnicity of police employees grouped into 4 categories: Black or African American, Hispanic, White, Other.

info.label: Body Worn Camera Activation
info.notes: A field indicating whether a Body Worn Camera was activated or not activated during the Use of Force incident.

info.label: Policy Outcome
info.notes: A field indicating whether the police employee was within policy, out of policy, or not available.

info.label: Police Employee Count
info.notes: A numeric field provided for ease of counting the number of officers for each incident. A value of 1 is displayed for each police officer per incident.
